g.text: 3V3 from the RP2350-Plus. SDA/SCL = GP0/GP1 (I2C0). INT = GP2.

g.desc: 3V3 from the RP2350-Plus. SDA/SCL = GP0/GP1 (I2C0). INT = GP2.

g.text: VBAT = the console's VSYS: always on while its LiPo is fitted, about 3.4-4.95 V.

g.desc: VBAT = the console's VSYS: always on while its LiPo is fitted, about 3.4-4.95 V.

g.text: RV-3028-C7, I2C address 0x52. Crystal built in.

g.desc: RV-3028-C7, I2C address 0x52. Crystal built in.

g.text: Firmware: enable backup switchover (BSM = 11, LSM) and store it in EEPROM;

g.desc: Firmware: enable backup switchover (BSM = 11, LSM) and store it in EEPROM;

g.text: keep the trickle charger off (TCE = 0, default): VBACKUP is the console's VSYS.

g.desc: keep the trickle charger off (TCE = 0, default): VBACKUP is the console's VSYS.

g.text: CLKOUT is on by default: turn it off to save current.

g.desc: CLKOUT is on by default: turn it off to save current.

g.text: 100 nF each on VDD and VDDIO, close to U1.

g.desc: 100 nF each on VDD and VDDIO, close to U1.

g.text: EVI unused: must not float, 10 k to GND.

g.desc: EVI unused: must not float, 10 k to GND.

g.text: 100 nF on VDD and on VBACKUP, close to U2.

g.desc: 100 nF on VDD and on VBACKUP, close to U2.

g.text: DRV2605L, I2C address 0x5A. ERM mode, effects triggered over I2C.

g.desc: DRV2605L, I2C address 0x5A. ERM mode, effects triggered over I2C.

g.text: Run auto-calibration once for the motor.

g.desc: Run auto-calibration once for the motor.

g.text: REG: 1 uF to GND. VDD: 1 uF + 100 nF. Motor: Vybronics VZ43FC1B SMD ERM, about 77 mA at 3 V.

g.desc: REG: 1 uF to GND. VDD: 1 uF + 100 nF. Motor: Vybronics VZ43FC1B SMD ERM, about 77 mA at 3 V.

g.text: Its leads are swapped (OUT+ to motor -) to keep the PCB traces apart:

g.desc: Its leads are swapped (OUT+ to motor -) to keep the PCB traces apart:

g.text: an ERM vibrates the same in either direction.

g.desc: an ERM vibrates the same in either direction.
